sentences.text: Shri S.K. Dubey - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State Heard on IA No.16407/2025 which is an application for ignoring the default.
From perusal of the checker's report, it is found that default has been removed, thus, the application IA No.16407/2025 is rendered infructuous and disposed of.

The question in regard to limitation in filing the appeal under Section 74 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Subject to decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court, issue notice to the respondents on IA No.14327/2025 and IA No.14328/2025 on payment of process fee within three working days by RAD mode.
Notice be made returnable within four weeks.
It is submitted by counsel for the appellant that the actual amount of compensation has already been disbursed to the claimant.
It is also submitted that appellant is ready to deposit the enhanced compensation granted by the Reference Court.

Subject to deposit of enhanced amount of compensation with the 2 FA-1037-2025 executing Court,
the operation of the judgment and decree dated 26.08.2022 shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The Executing Court is directed to invest the enhanced amount in Fixed Deposit in the nationalized bank.
Disbursement of the same shall be subject to furnishing of the security by the respondent with the satisfaction of the Executing Court.
Let the record be called for.
